newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber unchanged, no deals heard.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber unchanged, no deals heard.

text.p: Indonesian rubber offer prices were generally unchanged in late trading on Monday with enquiries not translating into trades, dealers said.
Dealers said there were enquiries from European and Singaporean dealers but their bids were well below offers and no trades were heard done.
"The market was generally quiet, although there were some bids at low levels," one dealer said.
They said January tyre-grade SIR20 was offered at 55.75-56.00 cents/lb fob Medan, 55.25-55.50 cents fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang, 54.75-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
